{{Quote|There is a whole strata of politics you have no exposure to. Did you think Thanaton was alone in his beliefs?|Darth Enraj to [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Darth Enraj''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], the master of [[Razer]], and an ally of [[Darth Thanaton]]. He was stationed to guard the [[Dark Council]] chamber on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to bar any intrusions during Thanaton's appeal, specifically interruption from Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]. Enraj strongly believed that he and his apprentices would be able to kill the politically-inept Sith Lord where Thanaton could not, but failed and ultimately fell to Kallig.<ref name="TOR" />
